prompt:
ground yourself in the cfd-bench knowledge, the cfd-workbench-proposl content and the current spec in this repo (and mockups)
for the current spec
- the foil section should be editable (even when starting with a pre-defined foil section like the naca 0012) i should be able to use splines/curves to reshape
- in both the foil section and outlines edits i should be able to "smooth" to have a constant curve where the splines are anchors for weights for the curve as opposed to locking the curve
- the analyze needs to  be able to show: Cl, Cd, Cl/Cd, Total Lift (at given speed and water type fresh or saltwater), Total Drag Lift and Drag should be in Netwons by default with ability to convert to imperial
- the simulation setup should allow me to specify fresh vs salt water, it should allow me to sweep across velocities and angles of attacks

update the spec and mockups... have the mockups be richer in terms of the analysis and simulation results... take inspiration from paraview results in terms of being able to visualize streamlines and be able to replay a parametric sweep in a 3d or 2d view to see things like separation and turbulence
